messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Mail from the party is collected on a daily basis by the Mail Processing Unit. Within this unit, the Mail Clerk sorts the unopened mail into the various business areas. The mail is then distributed. When the mail is received by the Registry, it is opened and sorted into groups for distribution, and thus registered in a manual incoming Mail Register. Afterwards, the Assistant Registry Manager within the Registry performs a quality check. If the mail is not compliant, a list of requisition explaining the reason for rejection is compiled and sent back to the party. Otherwise, the matter details (types of action) are captured and provided to the Cashier, who takes the applicable fees attached to the mail. At this point, the Assistant Registry Manager puts the receipt and copied documents into an envelope and posts it to the party. Meantime, the Cashier captures the Party Details and prints the Physical Court File.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="MailProcessingProcess" name="Mail Processing Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Collection" name="Mail Collected Daily">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectionToSort</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortUnopened" name="Sort Unopened Mail into Business Areas">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmndi:bpmndi xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI">
          <bpmndi:BPMNShape bpmnElement="Task_SortUnopened" id="BPMNShape_Task_SortUnopened">
            <dc:Bounds x="152" y="102" width="100" height="80" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"/>
          </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
        </bpmndi:bpmndi>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectionToSort</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SortToDistribute</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectionToSort" sourceRef="StartEvent_Collection" targetRef="Task_SortUnopened"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeMail" name="Distribute Mail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SortToDistribute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DistributeToRegistry</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortToDistribute" sourceRef="Task_SortUnopened" targetRef="Task_DistributeMail"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OpenAndRegister" name="Open, Sort Groups, and Register in Manual Incoming Mail Register">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DistributeToRegistry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterToQualityCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeToRegistry" sourceRef="Task_DistributeMail" targetRef="Task_OpenAndRegister"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityCheck" name="Perform Quality Check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterToQualityCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_QC_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToQualityCheck" sourceRef="Task_OpenAndRegister" targetRef="Task_QualityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_QCResult" name="Compliant?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_QC_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotCompliant</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Compliant</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QC_Decision" sourceRef="Task_QualityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_QCResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotCompliant" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_QCResult" targetRef="Task_RejectMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compliant" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_QCResult" targetRef="Task_CaptureDetails">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectMail" name="Compile Requisition List and Send Back to Party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotCompliant</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Mail Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RejectMail" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CaptureDetails" name="Capture Matter Details (Types of Action)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Compliant</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DetailsToCashier</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetailsToCashier" sourceRef="Task_CaptureDetails" targetRef="Task_TakeFees"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeFees" name="Take Applicable Fees Attached to Mail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DetailsToCashier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeesToParallel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeesToParallel" sourceRef="Task_TakeFees" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Split Actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeesToParallel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPostEnvelope</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrintFile</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPostEnvelope" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PostEnvelope"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrintFile" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrintCourtFile"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostEnvelope" name="Put Receipt and Copied Documents into Envelope and Post to Party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPostEnvelope</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PostEnvelope" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintCourtFile" name="Capture Party Details and Print Physical Court File">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrintFile</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrintToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrintToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrintCourtFile" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Join Actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrintToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Process Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MailProcessingUnit" name="Mail Processing Unit" processRef="MailProcessingProcess"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
